values.zh-CN: 配置 JSON 与数据版本

content.markdown:
Missing `config.json` yields migration status `missing`. A present file MUST parse as JSON; the inspection value MUST be an object rather than an array or scalar. An absent `version` is interpreted as legacy `0.0.1`; a present version MUST be a string matching strict numeric `major.minor.patch` SemVer with no prerelease or build suffix.

The current target is `0.1.0`. A greater version yields `future`. A lower version yields `needsMigration` only when exactly one registered forward chain reaches `0.1.0` without cycles, gaps, branches, or overshoot; otherwise it is `invalid`.
